parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing rigidity and support for other components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the door, drawer, and shelves, maintaining the overall shape and stability of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing foundational support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged panel made of MDF, used to cover and access the storage space inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage area and protects contents from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment made of plywood, located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a small, easily accessible storage space for utensils or small items.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails for access.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of plywood, dividing the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and helps organize the interior space.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height in some designs.
